_what: Every cell `OMR_WHOLE_REST_INK` fires on for Breitkopf & Hartel Brahms 1 mvt 1, pdf pages 0-3, adjudicated against the print by rendering each one at 600 dpi (the gather's own DPI) with this staff's five lines and the step-5.5 whole-rest tick drawn on it.
_frame_control: whole_rest_crops.py checks each page's Q.STAFF_LINES against the ink under them before writing a crop; it passed at +133 to +229 grey levels on all three pages that carry a fire.
_caveats: This is ONE reader's adjudication, this session's, against the print. It is not Sean's.

`record_corroboration` is INDEPENDENT of the crop: it is what the record's OWN detections on the neighbouring staff call the same ink, found by page-pixel overlap with no class matching. It agrees with the crop verdict on 8 of 12. On the other 4 no other staff detected the ink at all, so it can neither confirm nor contradict.
`exporter_state` is read off the record's saved `glyph_owner` / `pitch` / `duration` verdicts and is a LOWER BOUND on the cost; the A/B arm is what measures the file.

_tally._compare_litolff: 25 fires, 25 of 25 hand-adjudicated whole rests, 0 real notes (benchmarks/omr-note-where-silence-2026-09/adjudicated-25-fires.json)
